title: Validate docs/status.md evidence paths exist
summary: docs/status.md is treated as public capability evidence, but nothing currently enforces that backticked file paths still exist. Add a validator that parses backticked relative paths in docs/status.md and fails when they are missing, then wire it into the scripts validation gate.
expectedFailureModes: docs/status.md references files that were renamed or removed without anyone noticing.
The validator mis-parses non-path backticks and creates noisy false positives.
validate.sh --scripts does not run the status evidence validator, so the check never blocks drift.
nextAction: Implement validate-status-evidence.mjs, run it from validate.sh --scripts, and keep docs/status.md validation signals aligned.
